title: Audit changes to host firewall rules
rationale: Records firewall rule changes for later review but does not enforce packet filtering.

title: Audit access events for removable storage
rationale: Adds removable-media events to investigation records but does not prevent access.

title: Audit miscellaneous object-access events
rationale: Adds supplemental object-access evidence for analysts.

title: Audit group-membership information
rationale: Records group context during sign-in for later investigation.

title: Scan removable drives with Defender antivirus
rationale: Extends scheduled malware scanning to removable media.

title: Scan excluded files during a quick scan
rationale: Adds excluded content to quick-scan coverage.

title: Control visibility of Defender exclusions
rationale: Hides exclusion details from local viewers without changing active protection.

title: Delete RDS temporary folders after session exit
rationale: Manages temporary-folder lifecycle for an optional Remote Desktop Services deployment.

title: Block account details from the sign-in display
rationale: Hides account cosmetics on the sign-in screen.

title: Disable automatic restart while users remain logged on
rationale: Controls update restart behavior and system availability.

title: Rename the built-in administrator account
rationale: Changes the visible account name without removing administrative privilege.

title: Lock a session after smart-card removal
rationale: Defines smart-card removal behavior when that optional technology is deployed.

title: Reversible encryption for stored passwords is disabled
rationale: Prevents recoverable password material from being stored.

title: Do not store LAN Manager password hashes
rationale: Removes an obsolete credential representation that enables offline cracking.

title: Refuse LM credentials and refuse NTLM credentials
rationale: Rejects legacy credentials at the identity-verification boundary.

title: Disable unencrypted SMB password transmission
rationale: Prevents plaintext credentials from crossing the SMB transport boundary.

title: Require the SSL security layer for RDP connections
rationale: Enforces protected transport before a remote session is established.
applicability: Servers explicitly hosting RDP remote desktop sessions

title: WinRM credential storage is disabled
rationale: Prevents delegated RunAs credentials from remaining on a remotely managed host.

title: User Account Control Admin Approval Mode enabled
rationale: Requires administrative actions to cross the UAC approval boundary.

title: Enable EDR in block mode
rationale: Actively blocks malicious behavior detected by the onboarded endpoint sensor.
applicability: Servers explicitly licensed and onboarded for EDR deployment

title: Enable network protection in block mode
rationale: Blocks connections to malicious network destinations before content executes.
